meta.task: Build me a checkout page for an online store

defs.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
defs.genInstructions: Build a horizontal checkout progress bar across the top showing the ordered stages (Cart, Shipping, Delivery, Payment, Review) with completion checkmarks, active-step highlighting, and clickable steps that jump to the matching section. It orients the shopper and lets them move back to edit any completed stage.
defs.role: Serves as the navigational spine of the checkout, indicating and controlling which stage of the flow the shopper is currently completing.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When all required address fields pass validation and the shopper confirms the address, the form emits a 'shipping-complete' event with a short address summary; the stepper marks the Shipping step as complete with a checkmark and auto-advances the active highlight to the Delivery step.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
effectors.description: When card number, expiry, CVC and billing address validate successfully, the payment form emits 'payment-complete' with the masked card label; the stepper marks the Payment step complete and advances the active state to Review.

effectors.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
effectors.description: When the shopper clicks Place Order and the submission succeeds, the sidebar emits 'order-submitted'; the stepper marks every step complete and moves the active indicator to a final Review/Confirmation state.

targets.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
targets.description: Clicking the 'Cart' step emits a step-change event with id 'cart'; the cart panel scrolls into view, expands to its editable state, and focuses its first line item so quantities can be changed.

targets.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
targets.description: Clicking the 'Shipping' step emits step id 'shipping'; the address form becomes the active/expanded section, scrolls into view, and focuses its first empty required input.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: Clicking the 'Delivery' step emits step id 'delivery'; the delivery selector becomes the active section and scrolls into view with the currently selected shipping option highlighted.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
targets.description: Clicking the 'Payment' step emits step id 'payment'; the payment form becomes the active section, scrolls into view, and focuses the card number field.

defs.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable list of cart line items with product thumbnail, title, variant attributes, unit price, quantity stepper, per-line total, remove button, and a save-for-later action. It is the shopper's last chance to adjust what they are buying before paying.
defs.role: Holds the editable contents of the order and is the authoritative source of line items and subtotal for the rest of the checkout.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives a step-change event with id 'cart' from the stepper; scrolls itself into view, expands to its editable state and focuses the first line item's quantity stepper.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
targets.description: On every quantity change, item removal, or save-for-later action, emits the updated line-item array (id, qty, unit price, weight) and the recomputed merchandise subtotal; the sidebar re-renders its subtotal, re-applies any active promo discount, recalculates tax and grand total, and updates the item count badge.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: Emits the cart's total weight, item count and any oversized/digital-only flags whenever contents change; the delivery selector re-prices its shipping options, hides methods that are ineligible for the current basket, and recomputes estimated delivery dates.

defs.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a validated address form with contact email/phone, full name, street lines, city, state/region select, postal code, country select, autocomplete suggestions, a saved-address picker, and a 'save this address' toggle. It captures where the order ships and supplies the region used for rates and tax.
defs.role: Collects the destination and contact details that drive delivery pricing, tax estimation, and billing defaults for the rest of the checkout.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives step id 'shipping' from the stepper; becomes the active expanded section, scrolls into view and focuses the first empty required field.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: On a valid/complete country + postal code (debounced on blur), emits the destination {country, state, postalCode}; the delivery selector re-queries carrier rates for that destination, refreshes each option's price and estimated arrival window, and disables methods unavailable to that region.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
targets.description: When 'Billing same as shipping' is checked in the payment form, this form pushes its current address object so the billing fields are mirrored read-only; any subsequent edit here re-syncs those mirrored billing fields.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
targets.description: Emits the validated destination region and postal code; the sidebar recalculates the estimated tax line for that jurisdiction, updates the grand total, and shows the shipping-to address snippet.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On successful validation of all required fields, emits 'shipping-complete' with an address summary so the stepper checkmarks the Shipping step and advances the active step to Delivery.

defs.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
defs.genInstructions: Build a set of selectable shipping option cards (Standard, Express, Overnight, Store Pickup) each showing carrier, price, estimated arrival date range, and a radio selection state, plus a delivery-date preference and gift/delivery instructions note field. It determines how fast and at what cost the order arrives.
defs.role: Lets the shopper choose a shipping speed for their validated destination and feeds the resulting shipping cost and ETA into the order totals.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the destination {country, state, postalCode} when the address validates; re-queries carrier rates, updates each option's price and estimated arrival window, and disables or hides options not serviceable at that destination.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
effectors.description: Receives updated cart weight, item count and oversized/digital flags on any cart edit; re-prices each shipping option accordingly and hides methods ineligible for the current basket.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives step id 'delivery'; becomes the active section, scrolls into view with the currently selected option highlighted.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
targets.description: When a shipping option radio is selected, emits {methodId, label, price, etaRange}; the sidebar replaces its Shipping line with that price and label, re-runs tax on the new shippable total, and updates the grand total and displayed delivery estimate.

defs.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a payment section with method tabs (Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Buy Now Pay Later), a card form with formatted number, expiry, CVC, name on card and live card-brand detection, a saved-cards picker, a 'billing same as shipping' checkbox revealing billing fields when unchecked, and security/encryption messaging. It captures and validates how the order is paid for.
defs.role: Captures and validates the shopper's payment instrument and billing address, unlocking the final order submission.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When 'Billing same as shipping' is checked, receives the shipping address object and mirrors it into the read-only billing fields, re-syncing whenever the shipping address is edited.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives step id 'payment'; becomes the active section, scrolls into view and focuses the card number field.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
targets.description: On successful validation, emits {methodType, maskedLabel, brand, valid:true}; the sidebar displays the chosen payment method line and enables its Place Order button (and disables it again if payment becomes invalid or the method is cleared).

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On full validation of card/billing details, emits 'payment-complete' with the masked card label so the stepper checkmarks Payment and advances to Review.

defs.name: Checkout: Order Summary Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a sticky right-hand summary panel with a condensed item thumbnail list and count, promo/gift-card code input with apply and applied-discount chips, subtotal, discount, shipping, estimated tax and grand total rows, delivery estimate, a large Place Order button with loading state, and trust/return-policy microcopy. It is where all checkout state converges and the order is submitted.
defs.role: Aggregates cart, shipping and payment state into the final price breakdown and provides the single action that submits the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
effectors.description: Receives the updated line-item array and merchandise subtotal on any quantity change or removal; re-renders the subtotal and condensed item list, re-applies active promo discounts, and recomputes tax and grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: Receives {methodId, label, price, etaRange} when a shipping option is selected; replaces the Shipping cost line and delivery estimate text and recalculates the grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the validated destination region/postal code; recalculates the estimated tax line for that jurisdiction, updates the grand total, and shows the shipping-to address snippet.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
effectors.description: Receives {methodType, maskedLabel, valid} on payment validation; shows the selected payment method line and enables the Place Order button, disabling it again if payment validity is lost.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On a successful Place Order click, emits 'order-submitted' with the order total; the stepper marks all steps complete and switches the active indicator to the Confirmation state.
